sentences.en: Layla bought cosmetics at every shopping mall she visited.
sentences.zh: 莱拉在她去过的每个购物中心都买了化妆品。

sentences.en: There is nothing wrong with boys wearing cosmetics.
sentences.zh: 男孩使用化妆品也没什么不对的。

sentences.en: Beeswax is also one of the most commonly used waxes in cosmetics.
sentences.zh: 蜂蜡也是化妆品中最常用的一种蜡。

senses.zh: [化工]化妆品（cosmetic 的复数）；装饰品
用化妆品打扮（cosmetic 的三单形式）
